subject: reasoning
question:
Refer to the following series and answer the given question (all numbers are single-digit numbers only) (Counting should be done from left to right only.)

(Left) 7 5 2 1 1 6 6 9 8 6 1 7 1 1 9 6 7 3 6 9 9 8 1 (Right)

How many odd numbers are there, each of which is immediately preceded by an even number and immediately followed by an odd number?
solution:
**Given: **(Left) 7 5 2 1 1 6 6 9 8 6 1 7 1 1 9 6 7 3 6 9 9 8 1 (Right)

Now,

Odd numbers, each of which is immediately preceded by an even number and immediately followed by an odd number.

So, the needed pattern is: Even — Odd — Odd

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47ac672e6817623d0970f9044e7a709f4efa5f700352f9c5d723031e7449c912.png] 

 

Thus, there are four odd numbers, each of which is immediately preceded by an even number and immediately followed by an odd number.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 2**".
